<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex47012026-03-2310-47-35" status="unreviewed"><note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3840">dan</rs></note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3840">kha 1</rs> na re rang don rjes dpag gi sgrub bya'i <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> go ba prags kyi gzhir gzung ba la chos grub bsal med pa yin zhes zer | mtshan gzhi'i dbye ba yang sgra mi rtag pa laso pa chos dang chos can 2 ka dngos po yin na
               <lb n="39a9"/>tshogs don dngos po mtshan gzhi dang 2 ka dngos med yin na tshogs don dngos med mtshan gzhi dang gzhi dngos po la chos dngos med sgrub na gzhi dngos po mtshan gzhi dang gzhi dngos med la chos dngos po sgrub na gzhi dngos med mtshan gzhi dang 2 ka shes bya la mi srid na de 2 kyi rnam pa tsam cig mtshan gzhir 'jog ces zer | 2 pa de dgag pa la 3 ste | <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> mi 'thad pa dang |
           
            <pb n="76"/>
           
               <lb n="39b1"/>dbye ba mi 'thad pa dang | sgra don mi 'thad pa'o |</seg></TEI>
